title: Stork Oracle price can be arbitrated
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  `StorkERC7412WrapperModule.fulfillOracleQuery` is used to update the price of the Stork oracle.  Given that the oracle works with a push model, this opens the opportunity to arbitrage a price update by performing a trade, setting the new price, and closing the position, all in the same transaction.
